Who I Am

Hi, I'm Asad Bukhari 👋

I'm a BS IT graduate from the University of Education Lahore, and a WordPress developer & AI automation specialist based in Lahore, Pakistan.

My journey started with curiosity about how websites work. Today, I build complete digital solutions — from business websites that bring customers, to AI-powered tools and automation workflows that save hours of manual work.

What makes me different? I don't just write code. I understand business — marketing, SEO, customer psychology — so every project I build is designed to deliver real results, not just look pretty.
